# Filter requests within last 10 days (including today)
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

today = datetime.now()
start = today.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0) - timedelta(days=9)
end = today.replace(hour=23, minute=59, second=59, microsecond=999999)

filtered = []
for req in all_requests:
    created = datetime.fromisoformat(req["created_at"])
    if start <= created <= end:
        filtered.append(req)

print("Filtered count:", len(filtered))
print("Total amount:", sum(req["amount"] for req in filtered))
